description: This file contains shell script functions and notes related to firmware upgrade procedures for Buffalo devices with MediaTek MT7622 chipset. It includes device-specific notes, validation functions for firmware images, and upgrade procedures, particularly for TRX + UBI formatted images.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates a firmware image file for Buffalo devices, checking format, size, and compatibility based on the device's partitions and image metadata.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade for TRX + UBI formatted images on Buffalo devices, including cache drop, partition detachment, erasing, and writing the new image.
